brief: Inspect intake and exhaust louvres for blockage exceeding one quarter of free area, check damper travel, and walk the airflow path to clear any obstructions before the forecast heat event as outlined in SOP-015. Additionally, because the unit is of advanced age with a history of high loading and cannot be attended before an event if these conditions persist, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure in accordance with MG-023.
